subject: error message for geom_errorbar: non-numeric argument to binary operator

messages.author: 20b73f4748706290
messages.subject: error message for geom_errorbar: non-numeric argument to binary operator
parts:
Hello, 

I am trying to write a function for plotting an analysis and  keep getting an error message with geom_errorbar:

Error in geom_point(data = obs.ORR.df, aes(EXPOC, prob)) + geom_errorbar(data = obs.ORR.df,  : 
  non-numeric argument to binary operator

If I commented out the geom_errorbar, the following code would works.The location of geom_errorbar is highlighted. Thanks for considering help!

Xiaoyu




z.gnm.plot <- function(modelfit=gnm.emax, se.fit=T, type="response", 
                       quan.v=c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.625, 0.75, 0.875, 1)) {

    # data: predicted

     pred.gnm <- predict(modelfit, se.fit=se.fit, type=type)

     pred.df <- data.frame(RESP=pred.gnm$fit, SE=pred.gnm$se.fit, EXPO=model.frame(gnm.emax)[,2],
                           RESP.org=model.frame(gnm.emax)[,1])

     pred.df$CIU <- pred.gnm$fit + 1.96 * pred.gnm$se.fit
     pred.df$CIL <- pred.gnm$fit - 1.96 * pred.gnm$se.fit

     pred.df <- pred.df[order(pred.df$EXPO), ]


     # data: observed

     expo.quan <- quantile(pred.df$EXPO, quan.v, na.rm=T)
     EXPO.grp <- expo.quan[-length(expo.quan)]+diff(expo.quan)/2

     pred.df$EXPOC <- cut(pred.df$EXPO, expo.quan, include.lowest = T)

     TAB.count <- table(pred.df$RESP.org, pred.df$EXPOC)

     PROB <- TAB.count[2, ]/apply(TAB.count, 2, sum)

     obs.ORR.df <- data.frame(EXPOC = EXPO.grp, prob=PROB, logit=log(PROB/(1-PROB)))

     # data: errorbar for observed 
        library(binom)


     obs.conf <- binom.confint(TAB.count[2, ], apply(TAB.count, 2, sum), conf.level = 0.95, methods = "prop.test")
     obs.ORR.df$plower <- obs.conf[, 5]
     obs.ORR.df$pupper <- obs.conf[, 6] 

     ## plot: prediction line and shade
     
     gg.pred <- ggplot(pred.df, aes(x=EXPO, y=RESP)) +
       geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=CIL, ymax=CIU), alpha=0.2) +
       geom_line() 
     
     ## plot: prediction line and shade
     
     gg.obs <- if (type=="response") {geom_point(data=obs.ORR.df, aes(EXPOC, prob)) +
                       geom_errorbar(data=obs.ORR.df, aes(ymin=plower, ymax=pupper), width=.2)
     } 
     
     else {geom_point(data=obs.ORR.df, aes(EXPOC, logit), shape=21, size=3, fill="white")}
     
     gg.pred.obs <-  gg.pred + gg.obs
     
     print(gg.pred.obs)
}
              
              
 z.gnm.plot(modelfit=gnm.emax, se.fit=T, type="response")

messages.subject: Re: error message for geom_errorbar: non-numeric argument to binary operator
parts:
Hi:

Your example is not reproducible, but given the error message, I'd
guess that the problem is the operand on the left of the sum is a
ggplot object while the operand on the right is text. This **might**
work as an alternative (obviously untested):

if (type=="response") {print(gg.pred +

ymax=pupper), width=.2))
}
else {print(gg.pred +
geom_point(data=obs.ORR.df, aes(EXPOC, logit),
shape=21, size=3, fill="white")) }
Beware of mismatched right parens - I mess that up all the time :-/

Dennis
